title: Your support powers change | ASRC
text:

- Jana Favero, ASRC Deputy CEO & Head of Systemic Change

People sent offshore continue to experience the consequences of Australia’s harmful detention policies. With your support, we documented what is happening in our Hungry for Freedom report, exposing injustice and demanding accountability.

“When we first came to Nauru [Naoero] we were healthy. The longer we are here, the more sick we become and we cannot get treatment. We cannot afford to eat three meals a day. There is no resettlement for us. We are scared and we don’t know what will happen to us.”

– Anonymous person seeking asylum

Image: Budapest Hotel, refugee accommodation in Naoero (previously Nauru).

Image: Wasim, refugee formerly detained on Naoero, during a Delegation to Parliament, April 2026.

More than 700 refugees who have built their lives in Australia are still being denied the certainty of permanent protection. With your support, refugees have taken their stories directly to decision-makers, and 60,000+ Australians have backed the their call for change, signing our #LetThemStayForGood petition.

“Permanency could really change my life. As a kid my dream was to be a soccer player or a big business owner, but now all I can think of is getting safety, stability and permanency. That’s my only dream."

– Wasim

Your donation helps keep the ASRC independent, fearless and able to act when people's rights are under threat.

More than 15,000 people seeking asylum are denied the right to work, leaving people unable to support themselves and their families. With your help, we’re campaigning for a fairer system where people can work, study and contribute to the communities they call home.Former ASRC client Parisa now works at Metro Trains. She knows what having the right to work can make possible, and is calling for everyone seeking asylum to have the same opportunity.

“Work rights are vital for people. We are all hardworking people. We just want to have a simple life, that's it.”

– Parisa

Image: Parisa, former ASRC client, now rebuilding her life in Australia.

For 25 years, our community has shown that change is possible when we come together. Help us keep fighting for freedom, fairness and safety for all refugees.

If you would like to make your donation by phone, please call us on 1300 692 772 Monday-Friday between 9.00am and 5.00pm. For other donation enquiries please email us on fundraising@asrc.org.au

Join the community to stay informed on breaking news, ways you can take action and stories of refugees and people seeking asylum.

Need help from the ASRC?Call 03 9326 6066 (Monday - Friday, 10am - 5pm) to book an appointment.

The ASRC acknowledges Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples as the First Peoples and Traditional Custodians of the lands where we live, learn, and work every day.

We pay our respects to them, their customs, their culture, and Elders past and present. We recognise that First Nations' sovereignty and lands were never ceded. This land always was and always will be Aboriginal land.

As part of our commitment to First Nations justice, we support Treaty for Victoria. We pay the rent to Traditional Owners through paytherent.net.au
